title: US Army Combat Fitness Test (ACFT)
creator: US Army
description: The six-event Army fitness test of record from 2022 to mid-2025: a 3-rep-max hex-bar deadlift, a backward overhead throw of a 10 lb ball, two minutes of hand-release push-ups, the sprint-drag-carry shuttle, a maximum plank hold and a two-mile run, in that order. Rest between events is 2-5 minutes. In June 2025 the Army Fitness Test (AFT) dropped the power throw and kept the other five.

items.note: 3RM on a hex bar: 3 reps at a chosen load, one increase allowed (140-340 lb range)
Best of 2 throws, backward overhead, 10 lb ball
5 × 50 m shuttle (25 m out and back): sprint, drag 90 lb / 41 kg sled, lateral, carry 2 × 40 lb / 18 kg kettlebells, sprint; for time
Up to 10 min before the run
